description: This plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groups for various configurations of token multipliers and bit precisions, evaluated on LB-Avg and RULER4k metrics. The x-axis represents categorical layer groups, with discrete tick labels for "Layer1-4", "Layer5-12", "Layer13-20", "Layer21-28", and "Layer29-32". The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" and uses a linear scale ranging from -25% to 5%, with visible tick marks at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. Five lines are displayed on the plot. A solid yellow line with circular markers represents "LB-Avg of 2×tokens, 8-bit"; it starts near 0% at Layer1-4, dips slightly to approximately -1.5% at Layer13-20, and rises to just above 0% at Layer29-32. A solid red line with square markers denotes "LB-Avg of 1×tokens, 16-bit", beginning at 0% at Layer1-4, reaching a low of roughly -4.5% at Layer13-20, and ending just below 0% at Layer29-32. A solid light blue line with circular markers shows "RULER4k of 2×tokens, 8-bit", starting at approximately -1.5% at Layer1-4, experiencing a sharp decline to roughly -12.5% at Layer13-20, and climbing back to approximately -1.5% at Layer29-32. A solid dark blue line with square markers represents "RULER4k of 1×tokens, 16-bit", which begins at approximately -3% at Layer1-4, plunges to exactly -25% at Layer13-20, and recovers to roughly -3.5% at Layer29-32. Finally, a dashed grey line with no markers represents the "Baseline of 4×tokens, 4-bit", remaining constant at exactly 0% across the entire x-axis.
